 Game Preview: Warriors vs. Miami Heat - 11/5/26
 Kalyb Champion November 4, 2026 10:00 AM PST WARRIORS HOST FAMILIAR FACES ON THURSDAY 
The Warriors host the Miami Heat as two key championship contributors, Klay Thompson and Andrew Wiggins, return to Chase Center on Thursday. Thompson won four championships with the Warriors over his 13-year tenure, and Wiggins was the second-leading scorer for the team’s 2022 championship. The Heat’s biggest offseason splash was acquiring two-time MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo to pair with Bam Adebayo, who became the second-leading single-game scorer in league history with an 83-point game last season. The Dubs enter Thursday's game on a five-game winning streak. 
 All fans in attendance for Thursday's game will receive a pride fan. 
 Tap To Watch
 GET TICKETS 
 LAST TIME OUT 
The Warriors secure their fifth straight win with a 116-113 victory over the Phoenix Suns on Monday night at Chase Center. Stephen Curry paced the offense with 34 points, marking his third consecutive game with 30+ points. Charles Bassey tallied a career-high 19 points, leading the reserves in scoring. The Warriors rallied after trailing by as many as 17 points, pulling out a clutch finish in the fourth quarter. »Full Story 
 Golden State Warriors 
 Shop INJURY & ROSTER NOTES 
 GSW: Gui Santos (Left Knee Tendinitis), Kristaps Porzingis (Not With Team), Jimmy Butler III (Right ACL Repair /Surgery) and Moses Moody (Left Patellar Tendon Repair/ Surgery) are OUT. Team Notes 
 MIA: TBD. Team Notes 
 COMPELLING NOTE:  
 Warriors:  The Warriors enter Thursday’s matchup on a five-game winning streak, joining the Philadelphia 76ers and San Antonio Spurs as the only teams in the league to have won their last five games. The Dubs lead the league in offensive rating (121.5 OFFRTG) and made 3-pointers per game (18.0 3PM) over this span. 
 Heat:  Klay Thompson enters his second career road game at Chase Center on a heater, averaging 24.7 points and 6.3 3-pointers over his last three games. Thompson scored a season-high 30 points and hit a game-winning 3-pointer against the Los Angeles Clippers on Wednesday night, the front end of a West Coast back-to-back for the Heat.
